reference: MESH-0 (who holds the message; a composition of three generators, United States)
serves_registry_rows: delivery: the share of messages taken at once, held by the sender, handed to a host at home, or left to someone else; waits; the seat's queue by hour

set_by: two days of one person joined
members of a household drawn independently
verdict.reason: a composed count takes the lowest verdict among its inputs; an input used outside what it was scored on enters as unresolved

envelope.population: 100,000 generated households, 20,000 in each of five density classes with equal weight (not a country's class mix)
envelope.day: Monday to Thursday unless a row says Saturday

law: each share is a count on a generated population under stated settings (host, phone rule, join between days, tie share). None is a measurement of a network. The host settings run from a floor to a ceiling because nobody knows which households have a host that is on.
holds_no_real_feature: no person, household or place; a generated population
limits: no reading here says a mesh works: that needs a bound on hold time and a seat's capacity
household members are drawn independently and two days of a person are joined without having been scored
0.196 of generated adults are drawn with no smartphone and are not addressees; DEVICES-0 read 0.999 smartphones per adult on average; whether one adult in five has none was not checked here
senders outside the household are random adults on the same clock; no time zones, no tie between who messages whom and their hours
